description: Two-step self-review at every task lifecycle phase. Step 1 (this skill) runs in-context to gather session signals — files read vs grepped, user pushback, build evidence, degradation signs. Step 2 launches a forked subagent for unbiased code/plan review with fresh eyes. Combined report classifies findings as hard blocks or soft warnings.
